plugins.name: duckdb-skills
plugins.description: DuckDB-powered skills for Claude Code: read any data file, attach and query DuckDB databases, search DuckDB/DuckLake docs, search past session logs, and install/update DuckDB extensions.

skills.name: attach-db
skills.description: Attach a DuckDB database file for use with /duckdb-skills:query. Explores the schema (tables, columns, row counts) and writes a SQL state file so subsequent queries can restore this session automatically via duckdb -init.
headings: Option 2: in the home directory, scoped by project root path
Step 6 — Append to the state file
Step 7 — Verify the state file works
skills.description_zh: 附加DuckDB数据库，探索表、列与行数并保存SQL状态文件，供后续查询通过duckdb -init恢复。

skills.name: convert-file
skills.description: Convert any data file to another format: CSV, Parquet, JSON, Excel, GeoJSON, and more. Use when the user says "convert to parquet", "save as xlsx", "export as JSON", "make this a CSV", "turn into parquet", or any variation of format-to-format conversion for data files. Also triggers when the user wants to write Parquet, Excel, or other binary formats that Claude cannot produce natively.
skills.description_zh: 转换CSV、Parquet、JSON、Excel和GeoJSON等数据文件，支持写入二进制格式。

skills.name: duckdb-docs
skills.description: Search DuckDB and DuckLake documentation and blog posts. Returns relevant doc chunks for a question or keyword using full-text search against a locally cached index.
headings: Step 2 — Ensure required extensions are installed
Step 3 — Choose the data source and extract search terms
Step 4 — Ensure local cache is fresh
skills.description_zh: 使用本地缓存全文索引搜索DuckDB、DuckLake文档与博客，返回相关内容片段。

skills.name: install-duckdb
skills.description: Install or update DuckDB extensions. Each argument is either a plain extension name (installs from core) or name@repo (e.g. magic@community). Pass --update to update extensions instead of installing.
skills.description_zh: 安装或更新DuckDB扩展，支持核心名称或名称加仓库指定社区来源。

skills.name: query
skills.description: Run SQL queries against the attached DuckDB database or ad-hoc against files. Accepts raw SQL or natural language questions. Uses DuckDB Friendly SQL idioms.
headings: Step 1 — Resolve state and determine the mode
skills.description_zh: 对已附加DuckDB数据库或临时文件运行SQL，接受原始SQL和自然语言问题，使用Friendly SQL写法。

skills.name: read-file
skills.description: Read any data file (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, Excel, spatial, SQLite) or remote URL (S3, HTTPS). Use when user references a data file, asks "what's in this file", or wants to preview/profile a dataset. Not for source code.
skills.description_zh: 读取CSV、JSON、Parquet、Avro、Excel、空间或SQLite数据及S3、HTTPS网址，预览和分析数据集，不用于源码。

skills.name: read-memories
skills.description: Search past Claude Code session logs to recall prior decisions, patterns, or unresolved work. Use when user says "do you remember", "what did we do", references past conversations, or you need context from prior sessions.
skills.description_zh: 搜索过去Claude Code会话日志，召回既有决定、模式或未解决工作。

skills.name: s3-explore
skills.description: Explore and query data on S3, Cloudflare R2, GCS, MinIO, or any S3-compatible storage. Use when the user mentions an s3://, r2://, gs://, or gcs:// URL, asks "what's in this bucket", wants to list remote files, preview remote Parquet/CSV/JSON, or query data on object storage without downloading it. Also triggers when the user wants to know the size, schema, or row count of remote datasets.
headings: Step 1 — Detect provider and set up credentials
Step 2 — Determine what the URL points to
skills.description_zh: 探索S3、R2、GCS、MinIO等对象存储，列文件、预览和查询远程数据而无需下载，检查规模、模式与行数。

skills.name: spatial
skills.description: Answer questions about spatial data using DuckDB. Use when the user mentions locations, coordinates, lat/lng, distances, maps, addresses, "near", "within", "closest", geographic names, or spatial file formats (GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, GPX, GeoParquet). Also triggers when the user wants to find places, buildings, or roads — Overture Maps provides free global data on S3 with zero API keys. Handles spatial joins, distance calculations, containment checks, density analysis, and format conversions for geographic data.
headings: Step 1 — Understand what the user needs
Step 2 — Write and run the query
skills.description_zh: 通过DuckDB分析空间数据，进行空间关联、距离、包含、密度与格式转换，可使用无需密钥的S3 Overture Maps全球地点、建筑和道路资料。

headings: 2. Launch Claude Code with the local plugin directory
